text:
Isanti County recorded 30 providers with active licenses in 2026
Isanti County recorded 30 providers with active licenses in 2026, according to the Minnesota Department of Human Services.
Among license types shown publicly, Home and Community Based Services was the most common, with 11 active license records.
The total includes all providers with active licenses. Some active licenses are included in the total but are not broken out by type or listed individually below because of privacy, sensitivity, reporting-threshold or source-display rules.
